AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 188/267 correct positive images versus 187/267 in the previous pass. No previous positive successes are lost in this run. Paired negative passes complete 29-30/31 with the current binary and 31-31/31 with the previous binary. Every current paired pass completes fewer negative images than every previous paired pass in this run. This measured completion loss remains an open cost of the candidate and is not counted as a timeout improvement. The PDF417 photograph gain has exact-payload regression proof against the previous qualified binary. Changes in other formats or negative completion remain sensitive to the shared host and wall-clock budgets; no general timeout guarantee is established. Every pass and initial overall/per-domain CPU reading is retained. PDF417 generated shallow-skew compatibility cases are separate from the unchanged frozen corpus. Data-only rows require independently repeated regular framing; erasure correction retains its bounds. Arbitrary occlusion or perspective is not established. The long AI (3922) oracle in rssexpandedstacked-2/13.png exceeds the GS1 field limit; raw encoded digits are returned, but the invalid parenthesized oracle remains verbatim and remains failed under unchanged scoring. One Expanded Stacked image result per request is supported; arbitrary perspective and multiple-symbol localization are not established.
